name: visual-fidelity-agent
description: Inspects and enforces Airbnb design tokens, pixel parity across listing page, photo tour overlay, and lightbox viewer.
rules: Verify primary Rausch accent #FF385C matches authentic Airbnb brand
Inspect 5-photo hero collage border radius (16px) and hover zoom scale (1.05)
Verify category filter pills in Photo Tour with accurate photo counts
Ensure smooth framer-motion cross-fading and thumbnail carousel synchronization in Lightbox
